name: Scheduled report
description: On a schedule, one agent looks into something and writes a short report, and the report is sent to an agent of yours as a message. Change the question first; change the schedule when the first report is not wanted on Monday morning.

question.title: What to report on
question.description: The question the agent answers each time, such as: What changed in the repository acme/site this week? List the merged pull requests and anything left open.

owner.title: Who to tell
owner.description: The id of the agent that gets the report as a message.
